variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_sindex_entries, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { ns }
| fields ns

0.content: **Secondary Index Summary**: All secondary indexes of a namespace: entries, memory, garbage collection, queries. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

2.title: Sindex Count (total)
2.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
count(group by (sindex) (aerospike_sindex_entries{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}))

3.title: Memory Used (total) (bytes)
3.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_namespace_sindex_used_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }, rollup: avg)
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))

4.title: Memory Used (bytes)
4.query:
timeseries value = min(aerospike_sindex_used_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster })
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
4.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
min (aerospike_sindex_used_bytes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
avg (aerospike_sindex_used_bytes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})
max (aerospike_sindex_used_bytes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"})

5.title: Garbage Collected (total)  (rate)
5.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_namespace_sindex_gc_cleaned, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }, rate: 1s)
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))

6.title: Long Queries (max) (rate / one hour)
6.query:
timeseries a0 = max(aerospike_namespace_si_query_long_basic_complete, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }, rate: 1s), a1 = max(aerospike_namespace_si_query_long_basic_abort, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }, rate: 1s), a2 = max(aerospike_namespace_si_query_long_basic_error, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }, rate: 1s)
| fieldsAdd completed = a0[], aborted = a1[], errors = a2[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2
| fields completed = coalesce(completed[-2], arrayLast(completed)), aborted = coalesce(aborted[-2], arrayLast(aborted)), errors = coalesce(errors[-2], arrayLast(errors))
6.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
max (rate(aerospike_namespace_si_query_long_basic_complete{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[1h]))
max (rate(aerospike_namespace_si_query_long_basic_abort{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[1h]))
max (rate(aerospike_namespace_si_query_long_basic_error{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[1h]))

| fieldsAdd completed = a0[], timeout = a1[], errors = a2[]
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2
| fields completed = coalesce(completed[-2], arrayLast(completed)), timeout = coalesce(timeout[-2], arrayLast(timeout)), errors = coalesce(errors[-2], arrayLast(errors))

12.title: Sindex Count
12.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
count (group by (sindex)(aerospike_namespace_sindex_used_bytes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", storage_engine="pmem"}))
count (group by (sindex)(aerospike_namespace_sindex_used_bytes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", storage_engine="device"}))
count (group by (sindex)(aerospike_namespace_sindex_used_bytes{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^", storage_engine="memory"}))

13.title: Memory Used (bytes)
13.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_namespace_sindex_used_bytes, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rollup: avg)
| fields value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))

14.title: % Memory Used
14.query:

15.query:

15.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:

16.title: Garbage Collected (rate)
16.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_namespace_sindex_gc_cleaned, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), by: { ns }
| fields ns, value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
16.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum by (ns) (rate(aerospike_namespace_sindex_gc_cleaned{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", ns=~"$namespace|$^"}[$__rate_interval]))
